data.text:
Shaikh Tousib Bilal vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another
on 25 July, 2024 
Author: Shivkumar Dige
Bench: Shivkumar Dige
 1 928 aba.1272.24
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay,
 Bench At Aurangabad.
 928 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 1272 Of 2024 
 Shaikh Tousib Bilal
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra And Another
 ...
 Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Sartaj Khan H. Pathan. 
 App for Respondent/State : Mr. C. V. Bhadane. 
 ... 
 Coram : Shivkumar Dige, J.
 Date : 25th July, 2024. 
 P.C.:
 . Heard.
 2 Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 5th August, 2024. 
The learned App waives notice on behalf of both the respondents. 
3  In the event of arrest of applicant in connection with Crime No.177 of 2024, registered with Begumpura Police Station, District Aurangabad, for the offences punishable under Sections 328,
272, 273 and 188 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 26(1), 26(2)(iv), 30(2)(a) and 59 of the Food Safety and Minerals Act, he be released on executing personal bond of Rs.20,000/- with one surety in the like amount. The applicant shall attend the concerned police station as and when required and shall co-operate in the investigation.
